items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: I think he's the one that first came into Dreamland and spoke to me about recording.

ctx.x: He was the -- I think he's the one that first came into Dreamland and spoke to me about recording. But Mr. Supper, Mr. M. A. Supper, the white fellow -- J. Mayo Williams was a colored man, Negro man. Mr. Supper was a white man and a very fine, honest man.
